provenance: Team assumptions for a synthetic demo. None of these are Meesho's published fees or policies; replace them with authorised values before any real use.

notes.gst_rate_included_in_price: Listing price includes GST at this rate; the seller keeps price / (1 + rate) per kept order.
notes.platform_commission_rate: Share of the GST-exclusive price kept by the platform on kept orders. 0 is an assumption, not a statement of current policy.
notes.payment_fee_rate: Share of the GST-exclusive price charged on kept orders for payment collection.
notes.forward_shipping_inr: Charged on every dispatched parcel, including parcels that come back as RTO or customer returns.
notes.return_pickup_fee_multiplier: Reverse-pickup charge for a customer return, as a multiple of the forward fee.
notes.rto_return_fee_inr: Extra charge when an undelivered (RTO) parcel comes back. 0 means only the forward fee is lost.
notes.cancellation_cost_inr: Cost of an order cancelled before dispatch. Packaging, gift and shipping are not used.
notes.rto_units_restockable: If true, RTO parcels come back unopened and the product can be sold again.
notes.resale_refurb_cost_inr: Cost to put a returned, resellable unit back into stock.
notes.ads_cost_per_1000_impressions_inr: Only used when a seller enters a weekly ad budget: sponsored impressions = budget / this x 1000.

notes.candidate_high_vs_p75: Recommendations are capped at this multiple of the band's p75 for a new listing with no reviews. Prices up to explore_high_vs_p75 are still simulated so the app can say when the optimum lies above the cap.
notes.max_loss_probability: A candidate is excluded if its probability of a negative 12-week contribution exceeds this.
notes.max_budget_breach_probability: If the seller gives a loss budget, a candidate is excluded if the probability that cumulative contribution ever falls below minus the budget exceeds this.
notes.learning_max_optimal_price_width_vs_medi: If the 10th-90th percentile range of the best price across plausible price-response parameters is wider than this share of the market median, the app recommends a price test instead of a confident price.
notes.baseline: Reference strategy for 'probability of beating the baseline': 'median' (flat at the band median) or 'offline' (the seller's offline price, when given).
notes.prefer_lower_within_share_of_best_mean: Tie-break for the balanced policy: take the lowest eligible price whose mean is within this share of the best. 0 = pure maximisation of the mean. The simulation already credits lower prices with faster reviews, so a positive value double-counts that benefit.
notes.stop_loss_share_of_budget: Seller stop rule used when a plan launches below break-even: inside each simulation, the launch price is abandoned for the target price once running contribution falls below this share of the loss budget. Budget breaches are still counted.
notes.experiment_weeks: Length of the price test proposed by the learning policy; arms are held for experiment_block_weeks each, in the order mid, low, high, mid.

notes.price_slope_prior_sd: Prior guess of how much listings' own price sensitivity varies around their tier's slope (in log-conversion per 100% price change). Used so that a small training set cannot claim that every listing responds identically.
notes.price_slope_prior_listings: How many listings of evidence the prior is worth. The fitted spread is a weighted average of the data estimate (weight = listings with enough price variation) and the prior.
